purpose: Dallas NFL Gamecast production release-gating, asset-integrity and runtime rollback contract.

releaseGate.inventory: Every routed Dallas player/action must resolve through roster.json; supersets on disk never create runtime eligibility.
releaseGate.identity: Release is blocked if an asset disagrees with the locked official-headshot appearance reference, current uniform number, approved realistic 3D chibi proportions, camera, lighting, scale or foot anchor.
releaseGate.alpha: Production frames require clean transparent alpha with no matte halo, clipped silhouette, stray pixels or opaque background.
releaseGate.signatures: Named signature routing is allowlisted only for verified concepts already recorded in Dallas signature metadata.
releaseGate.fallback: A failed chibi release gate falls back to the existing non-chibi Gamecast presentation; it never blocks play data.

assetIntegrity.versionRule: Runtime references immutable versioned assets; replacement art increments version rather than mutating a consumed cache identity.
assetIntegrity.dimensions: Validate expected canvas dimensions and bottom-center foot-anchor coordinates before publishing.
assetIntegrity.decode: Validate successful browser decode and nonzero alpha bounds before an asset becomes preload-eligible.
assetIntegrity.football: Possession-bearing frames are checked against the single-football-authority rules from integration-04.
assetIntegrity.crossTeamGuard: Dallas manifests cannot resolve another team's player folder even if slugs or jersey numbers collide.

runtimeCanary.scope: Enable Dallas chibis independently from other NFL teams and independently from MLB/NHL presentation.
runtimeCanary.rollback: If identity, decode, animation ownership or football-authority invariants fail, disable the Dallas chibi layer and retain existing Gamecast data/UI without clearing unrelated caches.
runtimeCanary.recovery: Re-enable only after a new manifest/version passes the same release gate; do not hot-patch a consumed immutable asset key.

identityGuards.appearanceAuthority: current official Dallas headshot lock; never infer skin tone or visible appearance from name

checks: Roster inventory remains the sole action-eligibility authority.
Identity, number, alpha, dimensions, decode and foot-anchor integrity are release gates.
Only verified Dallas signature concepts are allowlisted.
Runtime rollback removes only the Dallas chibi enhancement and preserves base Gamecast.
Immutable asset versions prevent stale cache identity from silently changing art.
No MLB/NHL runtime, cache or metadata dependency is introduced.
